content.comment_body: Thanks [user_name], I wasn't aware that [product_name] [version_no] could actually be installed on Windows 10. I probably overlooked checking the compatibility of [product_name] [version_no] with Windows 10, since most recent [company_name] PLC software isn't known to work with Windows 10. I'll definitely give it a try on Windows 10 now. Thanks for sharing this information. Best regards, --- Note: Split from discussion about Ethernet cable length.
There is an attachment containing a page from the online help documentation.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are surprised to learn that [product_name] [version_no] is compatible with Windows 10, reflecting a common belief that [company_name] PLC software usually lacks support for newer Windows versions. This uncertainty about compatibility often leads to reluctance or delays in installing or updating essential software. The conversation shows that clear and accessible compatibility information directly improves user confidence and smooths the adoption process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] PLC software such as [product_name] to work reliably on up-to-date Windows systems and want compatibility details to be easily accessible and clearly communicated.
